The optimization process will continue for 11 iterations. Plan your strategy accordingly to identify as many good solutions as possible. 5. Insights gained from previous iterations, including patterns or motifs that lead to lower distances. d. The need to explore diverse sequences while also refining promising solutions. Remember to maintain a clear and concise format for your proposed sequences and explanations.
